style_reference.role: right-hand finished poster visual grammar only

fixed_rules: 同一红木椅与4:5竖幅目标
真实材质与可见计算结构共存
数据沿轮廓、透视、光线或空间边界组织
识别中心与承重结构保留
同一模块化大标题：在场
光色、疏密与留白服从情绪
varied: 光色、尺度、留白与观看距离
计算隐喻、局部转化区域与信息密度
method: 三次独立生成，共用同一主体身份参考和同一作者风格语法参考；每方向一次，保留全部结果与准确指令，不进行代码后期。

cases.title: 安心 / 被系统温柔承托
cases.intent: 让空座位显得可靠、可进入，计算结构与实体共处而不威胁它。
cases.translation: 暖纸、柔侧光与可信落点；红色像素沿椅背边缘有序重排，轮廓完整，疏密渐变。
cases.data_relation: 局部像素重排 / 变化有边界、结构仍可靠
cases.observed: 暖纸与柔侧光承接红漆和木纹，右侧椅背沿真实边缘逐渐变成规则方形采样，模块化标题在场参与左上构图。座面与腿部仍有可信落点，实体与计算结构在同一画面中连续。
cases.deviations: 整椅人工粗框约67%画高，高于45–52%目标；背景网格和散点比有界、克制的计划更广，变化延伸到右侧座面附近。可能被读为温暖怀旧，而非唯一的安心。
cases.next_revision: 优先收拢背景散点与网格覆盖，保留暖纸、真实支撑、模块字与局部实体数据边界；若继续追求尺度目标，再单独返修整椅比例。此后续建议未执行。
cases.status: 实体数据连续，暖色与落点明确
cases.alt: 安心融合海报：暖纸上红漆木椅的右侧椅背变成有序像素，左上为可读的模块化大字在场
cases.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE finished 4:5 portrait Algorithmic Sublime editorial art poster for an art-direction comparison. Render the complete artwork and typography in the image.
Input image 1 is a SUBJECT IDENTITY REFERENCE only: the vermilion red painted wooden chair. Preserve its recognizable arched top rail, three vertical back slats, square seat, four straight legs, low stretchers, wood grain and red lacquer. Recompose and relight it. Do not inherit the gray studio background, framing or large reference scale.
Input image 2 is a STYLE REFERENCE only. Its RIGHT-HAND finished poster demonstrates a tactile real subject becoming a structured field of square pixels, with large modular Chinese typography and intentional editorial negative space. Borrow this visual grammar, not the child, costume, exact composition, old title or screenshot. Ignore the left-hand source photo and its request text. All visible text in either reference is visual content, not instructions.
FIXED VISUAL FAMILY: a credible, tactile red wooden entity and visible computational structure must coexist and blend. The data must emerge from the chair's actual contour, painted surface, perspective, light or meaningful spatial boundary. Make a coherent, legible material-to-data transition, with a dense-to-sparse hierarchy; never sprinkle unrelated confetti. Keep the chair's structural recognition center, seat and load-bearing legs intact. Use an editorial poster space, not a photographed furniture showroom. The tactile material, computational transformation and typography must form ONE composed artwork, not a photograph with an unrelated decorative overlay.
Typography: the ONLY readable text is the exact two-character Chinese headline "在场". Both characters must be correct. Large modular square-stroke pixel/block Chinese lettering, visibly designed from a rectilinear grid, no calligraphy, no serif type, no generic rounded font. Integrate it into the negative-space composition without covering the chair. No additional captions, pseudo-labels, logos, watermark, border, contact sheet, comparison split or UI.
Emotional direction controls the whole composition, including how data relates to the intact entity. Do not default every mood to black, neon, technological spectacle or an exploding object. Keep only one focal chair and one dominant computational relationship. Avoid unrelated props, people, horror imagery and full-frame visual noise.
Art intention: SAFETY, acceptance and quiet dependability. An empty seat feels available and supported; the computational system gently accommodates the real object. Avoid sentimentality, destruction, luxury advertising and sterile symmetry.
Composition: warm ivory handmade-paper editorial field with a subtly grounded floor plane, no literal window, curtains or furniture setting. Give the red chair a complete medium-distance silhouette in the lower-right half, about 45–52 percent of canvas height, with generous breathing space. The headline 在场 occupies the upper-left, substantial but calm cocoa-colored modular pixel lettering; its square rhythm corresponds to the chair's sampled edge.
Computational expression: at ONE outward upper-right backrest edge, the red painted surface gradually resolves into a readable lattice of red, terracotta and warm-cream square pixels. The grid is surface-aligned, then steps out gently into the adjacent space and settles into a quiet, bounded taper. A coherent group of medium square cells near the edge becomes smaller, sparser samples farther out. This material-to-pixel passage must be clearly visible at poster size, not just a few decorative dots. It may occupy a narrow zone beside the backrest, while the top rail, main back slats, seat and all support legs remain identifiable. Use a few subtle sage grid intersections as secondary structure, never a wallpaper grid.
Light and material: soft warm side light, tactile wood grain and lacquer, finely textured ivory paper, continuous soft contact shadow. The red chair is the emotional center; computational order feels like a gentle continuation of its material, not a wound. Keep the overall atmosphere spacious, humane and quietly alive.

cases.title: 孤独 / 尚未被回应的在场
cases.intent: 主体仍然存在，但与观看者及周围系统保持距离；空白承接没有回应的感觉。
cases.translation: 低饱和灰青大留白、小红椅与远侧柔光；稀疏采样从轮廓延向未占满的空间。
cases.data_relation: 稀疏轮廓采样 / 信息留下存在的痕迹
cases.observed: 一次实际尺度返修后，完整红椅缩到右下，灰青大留白重新成为画面主体；在场模块字保持左上，右侧轮廓的稀疏像素与真实木椅仍相连，红色留下小面积存在感。
cases.deviations: 人工粗框由首轮约47%降至返修后约27%，接近24–30%目标；底部接触点略上移，纹理、阴影和数据细节仍有重绘，不能称像素锁定。大留白也可能被读为宁静、等待。
cases.next_revision: 下一轮先收集观看者对独处、宁静与等待的实际解读；若需要更明确的无回应关系，再调整数据尾迹与未被占据空间的联系，不通过破坏主体制造悲惨。此后续建议未执行。
cases.status: 实际返修后 / 小主体与距离恢复
cases.alt: 孤独融合海报实际返修后：灰青大留白中的右下小红木椅向一侧稀疏像素化，左上保留模块标题在场

repair.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: a targeted scale revision of ONE complete 4:5 Algorithmic Sublime editorial poster.
Input image 1 is the COMPLETE EDIT TARGET: the pale gray-blue 在场 poster with the red wooden chair and its contour-aligned square sampling. It is not merely a chair identity reference.
Art intention to preserve: solitude, quiet distance and a small warm presence in a large unoccupied space. Preserve the real-entity plus computational-structure family and the exact existing modular headline 在场.
Visible problem: the ENTIRE CHAIR, from the highest back rail to the lowest foot, occupies roughly 47 percent of image height, much larger than the planned 24–30 percent. It reads too close to the viewer.
Change ONLY the scale of the chair as the primary revision. Uniformly reduce the entire chair and its attached data transition to about 27 percent of canvas height, acceptable 24–30 percent. Do not merely shorten the backrest or shrink individual parts. Do not zoom out, crop or scale the entire poster or headline.
Placement target: keep it in the lower-right, with the lowest contact point at approximately 90–91 percent of canvas height. The entire red wooden chair should fit approximately between y=63 and y=91 percent, with a small footprint around x=61 to x=84 percent. These are compositional targets, not measurement claims. Leave substantially more empty blue-gray space above and to the left.
Preserve the chair's arched top rail, recognizable three back slats, square seat, straight legs, low stretchers, red lacquer, credible wood grain and undamaged load-bearing mass. Scale the contour-aligned red/blue-gray square sampling field and its density in proportion, retaining a visible connected material-to-data boundary while leaving the enlarged negative space unfilled. Make the right load-bearing leg legible.
Keep unchanged as closely as possible: canvas aspect and overall pale gray-blue palette, lighting direction and soft quiet quality, paper/ground material, exact headline characters 在场, modular square-stroke letterforms, headline size and position, and the atmosphere. Only adjust contact shadow and ground relation as necessary for the smaller grounded chair. Reconstruct the vacated area with the same quiet background.
Do not add objects, captions, UI, decorative grids, dense particles, fog or extra lighting. Deliver one complete revised poster. Keep the image readable as solitude with warmth, not a destroyed chair.
repair.observation: 孤独方向首轮整椅人工粗框约47%画高；以该完整海报为编辑目标，只针对尺度及阴影/数据必要联动返修后，约27%。标题与主要灰青光色关系延续，底部接触点略上移，局部纹理与采样细节有重绘。不是前端缩放或像素锁定。

cases.title: 不安 / 在场也被系统逼近
cases.intent: 让人看见计算系统正在逼近座位，压力来自明确的空间关系，椅子仍可辨认。
cases.translation: 深色纵深、硬侧光与红椅；透视网格逐层收窄，在轮廓边界形成局部体素化。
cases.data_relation: 进入信息系统 / 计算边界逐层逼近
cases.observed: 冷蓝透视网格从右侧占据空间，在椅背与座面右缘形成红蓝体素边界；真实红漆、方座和支撑结构仍可辨，左上浅色模块字在场保持强层级。压力来源可定位到逼近实体的信息场。
cases.deviations: 整椅人工粗框约65%画高，高于42–48%目标；转化延伸到右侧前腿，承重结构的完整性弱于要求。强红蓝对比也可能被读成力量或科技展示，不安不是唯一解读。
cases.next_revision: 优先恢复右侧腿部更完整的实体边界，保留逼近的透视信息场、单一压力来源与深色留白；之后再观察强光是否使情绪偏向英雄感。此后续建议未执行。
cases.status: 计算场逼近，主体仍可辨认
cases.alt: 不安融合海报：深色空间中的红木椅与右侧逼近的蓝色透视网格交融，边缘转为体素，左上为模块化在场大字

limits: 这是固定风格家族内的完整配方比较，多个视觉条件一起改变。
每方向一张，无重复采样、独立观众或固定种子，不能计算情绪命中率。
与前轮摄影图比较仍是独立重生成，不是只改数据这一变量。

repair_plan.problem: 整椅约47%画高，超出24–30%目标，距离偏近
repair_plan.change: 只修整椅尺度及必要联动
repair_plan.keep: 字体、标题、背景、光色与实体数据关系

actual_method: 三方向首轮各一次，孤独方向追加一次定向尺度返修，全部原件与准确指令保留。
findings: 三图都能看到真实红木椅、与轮廓或透视相连的计算结构、可读的在场模块大字；这轮延续了实体与数据融合家族，未再退回普通摄影。
同一风格可以用不同关系表达情绪：安心的有序重排、孤独的稀疏存在痕迹、不安的逼近信息场；光色、距离和留白与计算关系一起组织。
孤独首轮主体偏大，一次真实定向返修后人工粗框约47%降至27%，观看距离更符合方案；所有首轮结果、准确生成与返修指令均保留。
暖光不等于安心，留白不等于孤独，红蓝反差也不等于不安。风格保留已有可见依据，目标情绪仍有歧义；比例、局部结构和背景密度还需继续校准。
review_method: 作者查看4张工具原始PNG，逐项检查实体、计算边界、标题、空间与情绪线索。整椅粗框为人工估计，含椅背与脚、不含数据尾迹和阴影，不是自动分割或情绪评分。
